body:
1. In sidecars/server.mjs line 151, resolve static assets by checking join(__dirname, safePath) and falling back to join(__dirname, '..', 'sidecars', safePath) so dist/agb.mjs serves dashboard files.
2. In bin/agb.mjs line 432, change dynamic plugin name to valid kebab-case 'agb-dynamic-sidecar'. Update test/fixtures/fake-agy to validate plugin names.
3. In bin/agb.mjs line 371, remove dead unsafeOpen variable and dead CLI references.
4. In sidecars/jetski-launcher.mjs line 63, align /events offset pagination to byte offsets matching server.mjs.

Verification: npm test && node test/sidecar.test.mjs
title: Fix bundled sidecar static assets 404, kebab-case dynamic plugin name, and /events offset
